news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.79.2: Paladin seal timer fixed
news.text: The countdown on the Paladin seal icon sometimes started at 1800 instead of 30 seconds. It now always starts at 30.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.76.0: every look has its own layout
news.text: The window looks have been rebuilt: each one now has its own shape, buttons and Home page instead of just other colours. Two new light looks (Scribe's Tome and Gnomish Workshop) and a gallery to try them: click the Theme button on Home, pick a card, keep it or go back.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.68.0: themes for the window
news.text: Home has a new Theme button with four more looks besides the current one: Azeroth Reforged, Obsidian Night, Ember & Iron and Frost & Void. The choice is remembered. Also new in 0.67.0: a recorder that notes where items drop, who sells them and what quests give, to build our own item database.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.66.7: copy items from the shopping list
news.text: On the Plan tab's quest shopping list you can now click an item to get its name ready to copy and paste into the auction house. The Druid macros no longer talk about runes (Forever has none) and the macros for spells Forever does not have are removed.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.66.6: no-weather option, fresher gear lists
news.text: Home has a new quick setting that turns off rain, snow and dust particles. The Mr.BiZ best-in-slot lists on the site and in the addon follow the latest beta data (31 best picks changed), and Rogues now get axe rewards on their Plan tab weapon lines.

news.title: Builds: cheat sheets for every class (Level 30 and 60)
news.text: Every build on the Builds page now has a short cheat sheet beside it: the stat order and what to press, for each spec. Level 30 follows the Forever guides. Level 60 uses the Classic order for now and says so, because Forever has not published its hit caps yet. Click Level 60 and the sheet switches.

news.title: Builds: bear tank cheat sheet for Druids (Level 30 and 60)
news.text: The Feral Druid build now has a short cheat sheet beside it at both Level 30 and Level 60: the stat order and a rotation for a damage tank and a pure tank, plus which green item suffixes to look for. Click Level 60 and the sheet switches to the 60 version.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.66.5: builds updated for the new talent trees
news.text: Wowhead changed the Forever talent trees, so every recommended build, on the Builds page and in the addon, was checked and rebuilt for the new trees. The combat banner can now be resized and moved, and a stray /reload message is gone.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.66.4: timers that keep going in a fight
news.text: The Paladin seal and Rogue Slice and Dice timers no longer disappear in combat: they keep counting (marked with a ~ when the game hides your buffs). There is also an optional Entering Combat / Leaving Combat banner in Tweaks > Alerts.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.66.3: quest shopping list
news.text: The addon's Plan tab has a Quest shopping list: the quests whose items you can buy instead of farm, with counts and tick boxes. Learn this build now learns all the points itself, the mail list keeps characters that share a first name, and the No food reminder stays quiet on flights and in capitals. The addons page also lists everything the addon does.

news.title: Road to Forever addon 0.62: pick your arrow
news.text: The addon's waypoint arrow now points into the scene like a real direction marker, and you can choose its look: a flat dart, a gold dart, a stone arrow, a block arrow, a compass needle, or three painted ones. The Talents tab shows arrows between talents, walks a build one level at a time and tells you the next point to pick, and there are new reminders for gear repair and for a missing, dead or unhappy pet.

news.title: More level 30 builds
news.text: The Builds page now has level 30 builds for Hunter Marksmanship and Survival, Warlock Destruction and Demonology, Rogue Assassination and Subtlety, Druid Balance, Warrior Fury (two-hander and dual-wield) and Priest Discipline (a leveler and a Healer / PvP one). Some come from several guides that disagree, so they are marked medium confidence until we test them in the beta.

news.title: Druid macros
news.text: The macro page now has Druid: 61 macros for Shared, Balance, Feral (Bear and Cat) and Restoration. Form-swap macros shift you into the right form first, heals and cleanses go on your mouseover, and rune abilities are marked as needing their rune. They're built from the Forever ability list and other Forever guides and not tested in the beta yet, so each form macro says what to check.

news.title: Mr.BiZ shows the best enchant on every slot
news.text: The best enchant for each slot is now on the closed row, and opening a slot lists the 2nd and 3rd best stand-ins. In the addon, Mr.BiZ also tells you which of them you wear right now.

news.title: Road to Forever addon: own arrow, upgrade arrows, training
news.text: The addon now has its own waypoint arrow (Plan steps, Mr.BiZ items, /bizway, Alt + right-click on the map, Ctrl + click on Questie icons), green / red upgrade arrows on bag items scored with your spec's weights, best enchants on Mr.BiZ, a required-level slider, what to train next, a 24-hour clock switch and weapon upgrades along the launch plan.

news.title: Enchants on Mr.BiZ
news.text: Open a slot on Mr.BiZ to see its best enchant for your spec, with the effect and the skill it needs. The name links to the Professions page. The front page's Best-in-Slot link now opens Mr.BiZ too.

news.title: New Warlock macros
news.text: Shadow Bolt, Corruption and Bane of Agony now cast on your mouseover, then your target, then your friendly target's target. A new pet attack mouseover macro is there too. Curse of Agony is called Bane of Agony everywhere now.

news.title: Talented perk switch for builds and the calculator
news.text: A new switch counts the Talented legacy perk (+5 talent points, you start earning points at level 5). Builds and the talent calculator then show the level a build is reached at with or without it. The Road to Forever addon has the same switch on its Talents tab.

news.title: Builds: level 30 and 60 only
news.text: The level 20 builds are gone now that the beta goes to 30. Pick a class, then Level 30 (leveling) or Level 60. The gold buttons are readable again too.

news.title: Mr.BiZ: where every item comes from
news.text: Open a slot and every pick now says where to get it: dungeon and boss, quest, profession or vendor. Turn off a source type and the slot shows the best item that's left instead of going blank. Source icons have their own colours too.

news.title: Mr.BiZ gets biz ranks and colours
news.text: Items now rank as Bizzest, Bizzer and Biz, and a gold The Bizz tag marks the best picks that are 20% or more ahead of the next one: those are worth chasing. Class and faction colours and icons in the pickers, icons on the source filters, and a level 60 option that shows what's coming at launch. The top bar is also in a new order: plan, character, then UI.

news.title: Mr.BiZ: best in slot for every spec
news.text: New BiS page: the best gear per slot for all 27 specs at level 30, with the next best picks, quality colours and Wowhead tooltips, source filters and a wishlist per character. The addon (0.30.0) gets the same list as a BiS tab with item tooltips; /biz opens it.

news.title: Warrior: Retaliation with a two-hander
news.text: New Warrior macro (General > Panic / defensive): swaps to your 2H and Battle Stance, pops Retaliation, then goes back to Defensive. Press it twice. Fill in your own 2H name.

news.title: Addon import now clears removed macros
news.text: Road to Forever 0.14.0: when you import a fresh string from the macro page, macros we removed from the site leave your in-game library too. Copy a new string after this update.

news.title: Warrior stance icon in the addon
news.text: Road to Forever 0.13.0 adds a small stance icon for Warriors: blue Battle, green Defensive, red Berserker. Drag it where you like, lock it and resize it in Settings.

news.title: Crafters: see every recipe we know
news.text: Our Road to Forever addon (0.12.0) can now export your professions. Paste the string on the new Crafters tab and everyone can see what you make, what it costs, and search “who can make…?”.

news.title: Venom can make more enchants
news.text: Bracer Strength, Bracer Lesser Intellect (BiS), Chest Minor Stats (same bonus as BiS), 2H Weapon Lesser Intellect (BiS), Lesser Spirit and Lesser Impact are now on Our crafts. Whisper Venom in game.

news.title: New front page pictures and an ideas channel
news.text: The front page now has four new paintings that take turns every two days. Got an idea, a tip or found a bug? Post it in #r2f-feedback on our Discord (link at the bottom of every page).

news.title: Professions: shopping list and craft or buy
news.text: Press “+ Shopping list” on any enchant or kit and the list adds up every material you need, with the total cost. Armor kits now say whether crafting or buying on the AH is cheaper.

news.title: Live auction house prices
news.text: Enchant and kit costs now use live AH prices (from AHledger), refreshed every 10 minutes. Pick your market; you can still type your own prices.

news.title: Professions page
news.text: Every enchant the level-30 BiS lists recommend, cheaper stand-ins you can use until then, what our crafters can make, and what it all costs.

news.title: Our own Legacy calculator
news.text: The Talent Calc page now has a Legacy mode. It loads Wowhead's latest data, so new perks show up by themselves.

news.title: Download addons from the Addons page
news.text: Tick the addons you want and download them one after another without leaving the page. Each card shows the latest Forever version, checked every day.

news.title: Library Books checklist
news.text: All 40 library books with a route from Stormwind and checkboxes that remember your progress.

news.title: Road to Forever addon (pre-release)
news.text: Our own in-game addon: import macros from the Macros page and talent builds from the Talent Calc. Still a test version until it has been through the beta.
